profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Sage
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer | Database & CMS Specialist | SaaS 

With a robust background in the computer software industry, I bring a wealth of experience and a proven track record of success. My expertise spans across various domains, including databases, Content Management Systems (CMS), Software as a Service (SaaS), .NET Framework, C#, and Java.

I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems and drive innovation. My strong skills and dedication to continuous learning enable me to deliver high-quality solutions that meet and exceed client expectations.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
-- Developing RESTful APIs using Java, integrated with Zuora for subscription billing and management.
-- Leading and mentoring contractors in the development of web applications using Angular and Node.js, ensuring adherence to best practices and project timelines.
-- Maintaining and enhancing a high-traffic eCommerce platform built with C#, focusing on performance, scalability, and user experience.
-- Full-stack implementation of eCommerce solutions, integrating Sitecore CMS, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Zuora to deliver seamless customer journeys and robust backend operations.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-- Designed and coded various parts of company’s major sites using C#, ASP.net and ColdFusion.  
-- Wrote components for integration with company’s backend CRM and authentication systems.
-- Worked on team that created and launched new .net eStores for peachtree.com and act.com.
-- Developed EDI site for Office Depot using xml and Coldfusion.
-- Wrote design documents and assisted with all aspects of project life cycle.

positions.title: Oracle Applications Administrator
positions.description:
-- Worked closely with Oracle Financials users and DBA to troubleshoot application issues.
-- Used SQL and Oracle Developer tools to perform data analysis and to extract data not available through standard reports.
-- Performed system administration tasks, including setting up new users, creating cross-
validation rules, and monitoring of concurrent processes.
-- Part of implementation team for Oracle HRMS. Responsible for setting up Oracle Discoverer reporting tool.
-- Worked with outside consultants to convert Financials to a multi-org configuration.  Assisted with setup for all modules.
-- Implemented previously unused features of Oracle Financials, including attachments, online context-sensitive help and budgeting.  
-- Implemented and trained users on Oracle ADI.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-- Worked on development of WebMD’s physician web site. 
-- Created templates and XML pages to work with company’s Java-based web server.  
-- Used ColdFusion and JavaScript to build intranet and online enrollment systems.
-- Assisted with proofing/editing of marketing materials and technical brochures.
-- Worked on team that developed and rolled out intranet within a one-month time frame.

positions.title: Special Projects Manager
positions.description:
-- Designed, programmed and developed content for company web sites.
-- Developed and maintained databases for tracking marketing leads.

volunteerExperiences.description: Graduate of the 2021 Master Gardener class.  Currently volunteering 25+ hours a year with Gwinnett County Master Gardener Association, working at public events and providing gardening information to the general public.
Corporate volunteer at the JA Discovery Center in Gwinnett, helping sixth graders run a business in a simulated environment and mentoring eighth graders with personal finances.
